## Cases (Guinea MoH sitreps, Aug–Oct 2014)

| Prefecture | First sitrep | Last sitrep | Cumulative cases | per 1,000 (window pop) | CTE admissions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Guéckédou | 04 Aug: 285 | 01 Oct: 362 | 362 | 1.24 | 924 |
| Macenta | 04 Aug: 39 | 01 Oct: 403 | 403 | 1.60* | 27 |
| Kissidougou | 04 Aug: 6 | 01 Oct: 8 | 8 | 0.03* | 0 |

\* prefecture only partly inside the window, so the rate is an upper bound.
- CTE admissions exceed cases in Guéckédou because the CTE also admitted suspects and patients from neighbouring prefectures. Macenta's CTE series drops to 0 on some dates: a reporting gap, not closures. Treat CTE series as evidence of *where* centres operated, not exact loads.
- WHO national weekly series: 90 rows, Jan 2014–Nov 2014; use 'Patient database' rows for calibration (more complete than sitrep rows).
